# Digital Rebuild

## About
Digital Rebuild is a web design agency based in Barry, South Wales, UK. We build modern, professional websites for UK small businesses — trades, restaurants, local shops, and service businesses — that get them found online, trusted by customers, and hired. We specialise in clean, fast, conversion-focused websites built from scratch with no page builders or bloated templates.

## Services and Pricing

### Basic — £299 (one-time)
Entry-level website for small businesses that need to get online fast.
- Up to 3 pages (Home, About, Contact)
- Mobile-first, responsive design
- Contact form and Google Maps integration
- Basic SEO and meta setup
- 14 days post-launch support

### Starter — £499 (one-time) — Most Popular
Full website for businesses ready to grow their online presence.
- Up to 5 pages
- Bespoke design and branding
- Advanced on-page SEO
- Google Analytics 4 setup
- Speed and Core Web Vitals optimised
- 30 days post-launch support

### Pro — Custom pricing
For larger projects requiring e-commerce, booking systems, or ongoing support.
- Unlimited pages
- E-commerce and online booking systems
- Custom integrations and CMS
- Ongoing retainer options available
- Dedicated account manager

All packages include: mobile-first design, SEO foundations, and a free 30-minute discovery call before any commitment.

## How It Works
1. Discovery Call — Free 30-minute call to understand your business and goals
2. Design Mockup — High-fidelity designs delivered within one week, two rounds of revisions included
3. Build and Review — Full site built and shared via staging link for your review
4. Launch and Support — We handle go-live, set up analytics, and provide 30 days of post-launch support at no extra charge

## Key Facts
- Based in Barry, South Wales
- Specialise in UK small business websites
- Bespoke code — no WordPress templates or page builders
- Sites load in under 2 seconds (optimised for Core Web Vitals)

## Industries We Serve
Plumbers, electricians, builders, roofers, landscapers, restaurants, cafes, takeaways, hair salons, beauty therapists, dentists, solicitors, accountants, estate agents, gyms, personal trainers, florists, and any local UK small business needing a professional web presence.

## What Makes Digital Rebuild Different
Most web design agencies use off-the-shelf WordPress themes and page builders that produce slow, generic sites. Digital Rebuild builds every site by hand — bespoke code, bespoke design — meaning your site loads faster, ranks better, and looks nothing like your competitors. We focus entirely on small businesses in South Wales and across the UK, and we don't disappear after launch.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much does a website cost for a small business in Barry or South Wales?
A: A basic 3-page website starts at £299. A full 5-page business website with SEO is £499. Larger or e-commerce projects are quoted individually. All prices are one-time project fees with no ongoing contracts required.

Q: How long does it take to build a website?
A: Most projects go from first call to live website in three weeks. Discovery and design take around one week, build and review take one to two weeks, then we handle the launch.

Q: Do I own my website after it's built?
A: Yes, completely. You own the code, the domain, and all content from day one. There is no lock-in, no proprietary platform, and no monthly fee to us unless you choose an ongoing support plan.

Q: Can you help my business rank on Google?
A: Yes. Every website we build includes on-page SEO foundations — structured data, meta tags, clean URLs, fast load times, and Core Web Vitals optimisation. For clients who need ongoing SEO content support, we offer this as an add-on.

Q: Do you work with businesses outside Barry and South Wales?
A: Yes. While we are based in Barry, South Wales, we work with small businesses across Wales and throughout the UK. All client communication can be done remotely via video call and email.

Q: What kinds of businesses do you work with?
A: Primarily trades (plumbers, builders, electricians, roofers), hospitality (restaurants, cafes, takeaways), health and beauty (salons, therapists, gyms), and professional services (accountants, solicitors, estate agents). Any UK small business that needs a professional website.

Q: Do you offer payment plans?
A: We are happy to discuss payment in stages — typically 50% on project start and 50% on completion. Contact us to discuss your options.

Q: What if I already have a website and just want it improved?
A: We offer website rebuilds and redesigns. If your current site is slow, outdated, or not converting visitors into enquiries, we can assess it on a free discovery call and recommend the best approach.

Q: Are there any ongoing fees?
A: The project fee is one-time. The only ongoing costs would be your domain name (typically £10-15/year, paid to your registrar) and web hosting (we can recommend providers). We offer optional monthly care plans for updates, security, and maintenance if needed.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Book a free 30-minute discovery call via the website. No commitment, no hard sell. We'll talk through your business, what you need, and whether we're the right fit.
